summary: A mixed legal and regulatory morning driven by NCLT operational crisis, FSSAI enforcement action against a major FMCG player, and major listing announcements from Reliance subsidiaries amid global market volatility.

bullets.text: 18 NCLT benches operating half-day sittings due to member shortage; Bar Association escalates to Supreme Court.
FSSAI files three adjudication cases against Nestlé India over '5 HMOs' and 'easy-to-digest' whey claims in infant nutrition products.
Reliance Jio and NSE begin investor meetings for major share listings as part of broader IPO plans.
L Catterton invests $30 million for minority stake in South Indian restaurant chain Nandhana Foods.
Curefoods revenue grew 23% YoY to Rs 916 crore in FY26, while Rebel Foods revenue up 20%.
